主要内容: On September 5, 2013, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE MKT:BDR) received a favorable ruling in a patent infringement lawsuit against K Tech Telecommunications, Inc. A California federal district court judge ruled in the Company’s favor on its motion for summary judgment, finding three of K Tech’s patents relating to systems and methods for updating channel information in digital television signals invalid due to prior art. Gary Klausner agreed with the Company’s argument that all of the patent claims K Tech had asserted were invalid by reason of prior art, including products from Zenith Electronics Corporation and DiviCom, Inc., which had offered for sale products capable of modifying PSIP data prior to K Tech’s earliest patent priority date of April 5, 2000. The Company will seek payment of its attorney fees and expenses from K Tech, though it is unaware if K Tech intends to appeal the ruling.
